paragraphs.text: South Pontotoc beat Lafayette twice at home Thursday night. The girls won 62–42 to reach 6–0, and the boys won 66–54 for their fourth straight victory. On the soccer field, Pontotoc’s girls and boys both shut out visiting Strayhorn.

The girls have won each of their first six basketball games by at least 20 points. Lafayette scored more against them than any of their first five opponents, but Thursday’s 20-point margin still left the Cougars unbeaten. The South Pontotoc boys are 4–2 after following two opening losses with wins over Bruce, Mantachie, Hickory Flat and Lafayette.

In Pontotoc, the Warrior girls led Strayhorn 1–0 at halftime and scored six times after the break to win 7–0. It was their second 7–0 home win in three days, following Tuesday’s victory over Grenada. The Warrior boys won 3–0 Thursday after beating Grenada 6–0 on Tuesday.

On the road in Belden, South Pontotoc’s girls soccer team scored both of its goals in the second half of a 9–2 loss at Tupelo Christian Prep. The Eagles led 6–0 at the break. South Pontotoc’s next varsity basketball games are Monday, when the girls face Shannon at 11:30 a.m. and the boys meet Alcorn Central at 12:45 p.m.
